description: Profile build bottlenecks across CI runs: per-step totals, averages, and share of total time, the slowest step, a first-half vs second-half trend in run totals, cache correlation, and steps flagged by a slow threshold.

runs.description: CI runs to profile (at least one)

conclusion.description: Run conclusion, e.g. success or failure (optional; carried, not interpreted)

steps.description: Steps in the run (at least one)

cache_hit.description: Whether the step hit the cache (optional)

slow_threshold_seconds.description: Average-duration threshold in seconds for flagging slow steps (optional)

name: analyze_build_times
